Ahri.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Ahri’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. The true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception on its return cannot be reduced by magic resistance.
Ahri.combo: After Ahri E Charm is down, close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk and slow her with Kassadin E Force Pulse. Follow with an empowered Kassadin W Nether Blade attack to restore mana, then use Kassadin Q Null Sphere. When chasing Ahri R Spirit Rush, first count how many more times your remaining mana lets you cast Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Ahri.escape: The moment after Ahri E Charm is down is your window to go in. If Ahri R Spirit Rush is down too, close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Ahri can create distance with the movement speed from Ahri W Fox-Fire, so check your mana for the chase.
Ahri.fight: Try to trade after blocking Ahri E Charm with minions or dodging it. If Ahri R Spirit Rush is down, use the chance to close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Before going in, account for the mana needed to chase and one Kassadin R Riftwalk to get back out.
Ahri.laning: Farm CS without pushing the wave; keep it near your turret. Give up dangerous CS and keep up in levels without dying.
Ahri.phase: Kassadin gets stronger later, so farm side waves to scale.
Ahri.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front. Wait until the enemy uses immobilizing abilities such as Ahri E Charm on your frontline, then go in. Once Ahri E Charm is down, use Kassadin R Riftwalk to reach the backline and deal damage. Before going in, save enough mana for one Kassadin R Riftwalk to get back out.
Ahri.watch: Stay behind minions because Ahri E Charm can set up its full follow-up damage. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit on the way back, so after dodging the first pass, move out of its return path too. Its return damage is true damage and cannot be reduced by magic resistance.

Akali.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Akali deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance and get enough health to survive the second hit of Akali R Perfect Execution. Kassadin’s magic damage is easily resisted by Akali’s high magic resistance, so consider penetration when increasing your damage.
Akali.combo: When Akali’s mobility ability is down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and slow her with Kassadin E Force Pulse. Follow with an empowered Kassadin W Nether Blade attack to restore mana, then use Kassadin Q Null Sphere. If Akali escapes, check your remaining mana and save a Kassadin R Riftwalk to get out before chasing.
Akali.escape: Don’t rush in when only Akali W Twilight Shroud is down; she can still escape with Akali E Shuriken Flip and Akali R Perfect Execution. In particular, close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk when Akali E Shuriken Flip is down, before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up. If you have the mark from Akali E Shuriken Flip, watch for its follow-up dash first.
Akali.laning: Against Akali W Twilight Shroud, look for the brief moments when her position is revealed or fight near your turret. After pushing the wave with Kassadin E Force Pulse, retreat into vision so the enemy jungler can’t catch you.
Akali.phase: Later, farm side waves and join fights as Kassadin R Riftwalk’s cooldown decreases with your growth.
Akali.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front. Wait until the enemy uses an immobilizing effect on your frontline and their formation breaks, then use Kassadin R Riftwalk to reach the backline. Deal damage with Kassadin E Force Pulse and an empowered Kassadin W Nether Blade attack, and save a Kassadin R Riftwalk and enough mana to get out. If marked by Akali E Shuriken Flip or targeted by Akali R Perfect Execution, use Kassadin R Riftwalk to create distance.
Akali.watch: When you have lost health, be especially careful of the second hit of Akali R Perfect Execution.

Akshan.build: Survive early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Akshan Q Avengerang, E Heroic Swing, and R Comeuppance deal primarily physical damage, so prioritize armor.
Akshan.combo: When Akshan E Heroic Swing is down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse → empowered Kassadin W Nether Blade attack → Kassadin Q Null Sphere, in that order. Before chasing, calculate how many more times your remaining mana lets you cast Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Akshan.escape: The moment after Akshan E Heroic Swing is down is your window to go in. In an open area with no wall for him to hook, Akshan can’t use this ability to engage or escape, so force him there and close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Akshan.fight: Right after Akshan E Heroic Swing is down, close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Slow him with Kassadin E Force Pulse, then restore mana with an empowered Kassadin W Nether Blade attack. Save mana for your next Kassadin R Riftwalk too.
Akshan.laning: Keep the wave near your turret, but avoid the path where Akshan Q Avengerang hits minions and gains range.
Akshan.phase: Early on, withstand Akshan’s poke and focus on scaling. Later, Kassadin gets stronger, so safely collect levels and farm waves.
Akshan.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front. Wait until the enemy uses an immobilizing effect on your frontline, then use Kassadin R Riftwalk to reach the backline. Save a Kassadin R Riftwalk and enough mana to get out. If you have Akshan W Going Rogue’s villain mark, fight outside his execute range so he can’t catch you alone.
Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang’s range increases each time it hits an enemy, so don’t let your guard down behind minions. Dodge its path both when thrown and on its return, and hide behind terrain if Akshan R Comeuppance starts targeting you while you’re low on health.

Ambessa.build: Buy Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Ambessa deals mostly physical damage and Kassadin has relatively low armor, so prioritize armor.
Ambessa.combo: Once Ambessa’s abilities and Ambessa P Drakehound’s Step charges are down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse → empowered Kassadin W Nether Blade attack → Kassadin Q Null Sphere, in that order. Restore mana with Kassadin W Nether Blade, but decide before going in whether to save enough mana for one Kassadin R Riftwalk to escape.
Ambessa.escape: The moment after Ambessa has used all her abilities and Ambessa P Drakehound’s Step charges is your window to go in. If the slow from Ambessa E Lacerate remains or you see the windup of Ambessa W Repudiation, first dodge the damage with Kassadin R Riftwalk, then go in after those abilities are down.
Ambessa.fight: Trade damage right after Ambessa spends her abilities and Ambessa P Drakehound’s Step charges. Don’t attack during the windup of Ambessa W Repudiation; after it ends, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and land Kassadin E Force Pulse’s slow and an empowered Kassadin W Nether Blade attack.
Ambessa.laning: If Ambessa’s poke is difficult to handle, it’s better to give up a few CS and keep up in levels. Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield absorbs magic damage, so don’t expect it to block Ambessa’s main physical damage.
Ambessa.phase: Later, make use of Kassadin’s scaling and Kassadin R Riftwalk’s shorter cooldown.
Ambessa.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front. Avoid lining up with your allied backline along the line of Ambessa R Public Execution. When the enemy uses an immobilizing effect on your frontline and their formation breaks, use Kassadin R Riftwalk to reach the backline. Save casts of Kassadin R Riftwalk and enough mana to get out.
Ambessa.watch: When you see the shield and windup of Ambessa W Repudiation, stop attacking and leave its area. Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam deals more damage at the edge, so dodge the first hit; if that’s difficult, move close to her. If hit by the slow from Ambessa E Lacerate, escape with Kassadin R Riftwalk before her follow-up attacks can reach you.

Anivia.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Anivia’s main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance.
Anivia.combo: Once Anivia Q Flash Frost is down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse. Follow with an empowered Kassadin W Nether Blade attack to restore mana, then use Kassadin Q Null Sphere last. Save mana for your next R and your escape.
Anivia.escape: After Anivia Q Flash Frost is down, engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Anivia has no mobility ability, so closing the gap once gives you a chance to chase. Look for a kill when Anivia P Rebirth has already been used.
Anivia.fight: Time Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield to absorb Anivia’s magic poke, and use Kassadin P Void Stone’s damage reduction to survive. After Anivia Q Flash Frost is down, close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk and trade damage. If Anivia P Rebirth is still available, don’t try to break the egg alone; go in with your team.
Anivia.laning: Give up dangerous CS if needed, but keep up in levels without dying.
Anivia.phase: Kassadin gets stronger later, so safely collect levels and resources.
Anivia.teamfight: Fight in open lanes rather than narrow jungle or river paths where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your escape. Kassadin shouldn’t engage from the front; wait until the enemy uses an immobilizing effect on your frontline, then use Kassadin R Riftwalk to reach the backline. Save enough mana to deal a burst of damage and escape with R.
Anivia.watch: Even if you leave the path of Anivia Q Flash Frost, it can still explode when recast and stun you, so dodge its blast radius too. If you’re hit by Q or caught in a fully grown Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals more damage, so immediately use Kassadin R Riftwalk to escape the storm. In narrow paths, Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape route.

Annie.build: Survive with a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Annie deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance to give yourself a chance to survive one combo.
Annie.combo: When Annie P Pyromania’s stun is down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and slow her with Kassadin E Force Pulse. Follow with an empowered Kassadin W Nether Blade attack to restore mana, then use Kassadin Q Null Sphere last.
Annie.escape: Annie has no mobility, so the moment after she uses Annie P Pyromania’s stun is your window to go in with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Annie E Molten Shield grants movement speed, so before chasing, count how many times your remaining mana lets you cast Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Annie.fight: Time Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield to absorb Annie’s poke, and don’t go in when Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready. Once the stun is used, close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk and exploit Annie’s short range and lack of mobility.
Annie.laning: Give up dangerous CS if needed, but keep up in levels without dying. After pushing the wave with Kassadin E Force Pulse, retreat into vision.
Annie.phase: Early on, Kassadin is vulnerable to Annie’s poke, so scale safely. Later, use Kassadin’s scaling advantage to farm side waves and prepare to join fights.
Annie.teamfight: Don’t stand grouped with your team when Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready or Annie is out of vision. After Annie’s crowd control is used on your frontline and their formation breaks, use Kassadin R Riftwalk to reach the backline. Save one Kassadin R Riftwalk to get out after dealing burst damage.
Annie.watch: When the white glow signals a stun from Annie P Pyromania, stay out of ability range. Annie R Summon: Tibbers deals area damage, so move away from where it is summoned and keep your distance from Tibbers even after killing Annie.

AurelionSol.build: Survive with a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Aurelion Sol’s main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance. Be careful about relying on health alone, since Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on max health.
AurelionSol.combo: When Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and slow him with Kassadin E Force Pulse. Follow with an empowered Kassadin W Nether Blade attack to restore mana, and save Kassadin Q Null Sphere for last so you can respond to Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight.
AurelionSol.escape: The moment after you make Aurelion Sol use W Astral Flight is your window to go in with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Also check whether Aurelion Sol E Singularity and the crowd control from R Falling Star / The Skies Descend are down. Before going in, save enough mana to escape with Kassadin R Riftwalk.
AurelionSol.fight: Look for an opportunity before Aurelion Sol stacks Stardust, but save enough mana to escape with Kassadin R Riftwalk.
AurelionSol.laning: Early in lane, farm CS and keep the wave near your turret; time Kassadin Q Null Sphere to absorb poke. Dodge Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light from behind minions, and don’t stay in it long enough to give him Stardust. After pushing the wave with Kassadin E Force Pulse, retreat into vision so the enemy jungler can’t catch you.
AurelionSol.phase: Kassadin has to withstand poke early in lane, but Aurelion Sol is also weak with little Stardust, so look for an opportunity when W Astral Flight is down. Kassadin gets stronger later, but Aurelion Sol’s Stardust stacks permanently too, so the more he scales, the more you must watch for his area attacks.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front, and keep your distance from allies so you aren’t all hit by Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. When the enemy uses crowd control on your frontline and their formation breaks, use Kassadin R Riftwalk to reach the backline and deal damage. Save Kassadin R Riftwalk and enough mana to escape again.
AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on your max health and stacks Stardust, so stand behind minions and quickly leave its targeting line. If caught in Aurelion Sol E Singularity, move outward immediately; when low on health, stay out of its area to avoid being executed. Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend applies area crowd control, and at enough Stardust also knocks you up and creates a shockwave, so keep your distance from allies.

Aurora.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Aurora’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots and prioritize magic resistance over armor.
Aurora.combo: Close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and slow her with Kassadin E Force Pulse, then use empowered Kassadin W Nether Blade attack followed by Kassadin Q Null Sphere. Restore mana with a Kassadin W Nether Blade attack to set up your next Kassadin R Riftwalk. If Aurora is stealthed, wait until she is revealed again before continuing.
Aurora.escape: If only Aurora E The Weirding is down, check whether Aurora W Across the Veil is still available. If both Aurora E The Weirding and Aurora W Across the Veil are down, and Aurora R Between Worlds hasn’t come back up, close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk and go in. Before going in, account for the mana needed to chase and one Kassadin R Riftwalk to get back out.
Aurora.fight: Time Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield to absorb Aurora’s poke, and survive using Kassadin P Void Stone’s damage reduction. Look for a chance to re-engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk after making Aurora use E The Weirding. If Aurora W Across the Veil is still available, save your abilities until her stealth ends and she is revealed again.
Aurora.laning: When Aurora’s magic poke comes, absorb it with Kassadin Q Null Sphere, and choose staying alive over taking dangerous CS. If you push the lane, retreat into vision so the enemy jungler can’t catch you.
Aurora.phase: Later, safely farm waves and join fights to make use of Kassadin’s scaling advantage.
Aurora.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front. Wait until the enemy uses an immobilizing ability on your frontline, then use Kassadin R Riftwalk to reach the backline. Look for an opportunity when Aurora has used her leap to engage and has not scored a takedown. Before going in, save casts of Kassadin R Riftwalk to escape, and don’t leave low health allies behind when you retreat.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again on its return, and the return damage increases with your missing health. If hit, move out of the line between Aurora and yourself; if low on health, retreat before it returns. When Aurora R Between Worlds appears, leaving the zone slows you, so decide whether to dodge before it appears or fight inside it.

Azir.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Azir's magic damage early. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and build magic resistance.
Azir.combo: Close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and slow him with Kassadin E Force Pulse, then land an empowered Kassadin W Nether Blade basic attack and use Kassadin Q Null Sphere. W restores mana to prepare for your next R; before chasing, account for the mana needed for one R to escape.
Azir.escape: Azir E Shifting Sands having just been used is an opportunity to close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Look to engage even after Azir R Emperor's Divide is down. If you see an escape route to soldiers beyond a wall, block that route or close in before Azir can escape.
Azir.fight: When Azir's soldiers are standing still or Azir Q Conquering Sands is down, circle around the soldiers to approach Azir. Use Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield to absorb magic poke, then deal your damage in a short burst instead of taking a long fight once you're close.
Azir.laning: Look for an opportunity to approach when Azir's soldiers expire or he runs low on mana, but don't risk dying for a few CS.
Azir.phase: Focus on surviving Azir's soldier poke and scaling on Kassadin early.
Azir.teamfight: Don't start from the front. After a displacement ability like Azir R Emperor's Divide is used or the enemy formation is disrupted, enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Approach from multiple directions in open areas, and save enough mana for an R to escape.
Azir.watch: Stay out of the straight line where Azir W Arise! soldiers are standing, and watch for Azir Q Conquering Sands moving a soldier to slow you as poke. Azir R Emperor's Divide can knock back an engaging Kassadin, so don't dive in first through a narrow passage.

Cassiopeia.build: Survive early with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Cassiopeia's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Cassiopeia.combo: To engage, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk, slow her with Kassadin E Force Pulse, then land an empowered Kassadin W Nether Blade basic attack. Use Kassadin Q Null Sphere last to absorb Cassiopeia's magic damage with its shield. Save mana for your next Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Cassiopeia.escape: Cassiopeia has no mobility, so Cassiopeia W Miasma having just been used elsewhere is an opportunity to engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk. If the cloud is already down, go around it instead of entering it. Also watch Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze's cast animation so you don't get hit while facing her.
Cassiopeia.fight: Dodge Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and approach along a path not covered by Cassiopeia W Miasma. When you get an opportunity to close the gap, engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk and deal a short burst of damage. If you've been poisoned, don't force the trade.
Cassiopeia.laning: Use Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield when Cassiopeia's magic poke comes in, and choose to stay alive even if it means giving up dangerous CS. If you've pushed the wave, retreat into vision.
Cassiopeia.phase: Late game, Kassadin's scaling and mobility become powerful, but Cassiopeia can also win teamfights with sustained damage if she is free to attack, so choose your engage timing carefully.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: Don't start from the front. Engage after Cassiopeia W Miasma has been used elsewhere or the enemy's immobilizing effect has been used. Use Kassadin R Riftwalk to reach the backline and deal damage, saving the casts and mana needed to escape with Kassadin R Riftwalk. When no fight is starting, farm side waves and scale.
Cassiopeia.watch: If you're hit by Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, her E Twin Fang deals more damage and restores her health while she's moving faster, so get out of range until the poison wears off. You can't use Kassadin R Riftwalk inside Cassiopeia W Miasma, so don't step into the cloud. If you see the cast animation for Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, turn your back to avoid the stun.

Corki.build: Survive early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Corki's main damage is physical, so build armor first. While Corki E Gatling Gun is reducing your resistances, getting out of its path is the priority.
Corki.combo: After Corki W Valkyrie is down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse. Follow with an empowered Kassadin W Nether Blade basic attack to restore mana, and use Kassadin Q Null Sphere when you need its shield. Before chasing, count how many more times you can use Kassadin R Riftwalk with your remaining mana.
Corki.escape: The moment after Corki W Valkyrie is used is your window to engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk. If you dive in while Corki W Valkyrie is available, he can escape over terrain. The available information doesn't specify when Corki's crowd control is down, so use whether Corki W Valkyrie has been used as your guide for deciding when to engage.
Corki.fight: Avoid long trades early and look for an opportunity just after Corki W Valkyrie is down. Close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk, slow him with Kassadin E Force Pulse, and land an empowered Kassadin W Nether Blade basic attack. Don't stand in front of Corki E Gatling Gun for long, and account for the mana needed for your next Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Corki.laning: Use Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield to absorb the magic damage from Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb or Corki W Valkyrie. If you retreat after being hit by Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, your position has been revealed, so immediately create distance.
Corki.phase: Corki also gets stronger as he collects items, so don't take away his chance to farm comfortably, while Kassadin stays alive and continues scaling into the late game.
Corki.teamfight: Don't start from the front. After the enemy's immobilizing effect is used on your frontline and their formation is disrupted, enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Avoid the path of Corki E Gatling Gun as you deal your burst, and save Kassadin R Riftwalk and mana to escape. While no fight is happening, collect side waves, then join with Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Corki.watch: If you're hit by Corki E Gatling Gun, both your armor and magic resistance are reduced, so sidestep instead of standing your ground in front of him. Corki R Missile Barrage can hit Kassadin behind minions too, so move out of range and reposition especially to avoid getting hit by the third missile in succession. Use Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield to absorb the magic damage from Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb.

Diana.build: Diana's damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first. Survive early with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Diana.combo: After Diana W Pale Cascade's shield is down and Diana E Lunar Rush has been used, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse. Follow with a basic attack empowered by Kassadin W Nether Blade, then finish with Kassadin Q Null Sphere. Consecutive Rs cost a lot of mana, so save enough to escape.
Diana.escape: If you're hit by Diana Q Crescent Strike's mark, Diana E Lunar Rush may follow, so create distance with Kassadin R Riftwalk. If Diana uses E first without Q and doesn't get a cooldown reset, that's an opportunity to slow her with Kassadin E Force Pulse and engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Diana.fight: After dodging Diana Q Crescent Strike, close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk when Diana E Lunar Rush is down. If Diana engages first with E without Q, slow her with Kassadin E Force Pulse and trade. It's better to fight after Diana W Pale Cascade's shield is down.
Diana.laning: Don't force a push. Keep the wave near your turret, and you can give up dangerous CS.
Diana.phase: Kassadin becomes powerful late game, so avoid dying early and give yourself time to scale.
Diana.teamfight: Diana R Moonfall deals more damage the more enemies it pulls in, so spread out from your allies and watch for flanks. Don't start from the front. After the enemy's immobilizing ability is used on your frontline, enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Save an R and enough mana to escape before engaging.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it flies and marks you, so dodge sideways instead of only retreating. If you're marked, Diana E Lunar Rush can have its cooldown reset, so immediately create distance. Don't fight in close quarters just after Diana activates W Pale Cascade; wait for its shield and orbs to disappear.

Ekko.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ekko's damage is mostly magic, and Kassadin has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Ekko.combo: After Ekko's main escape tools are down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse. Follow with an empowered Kassadin W Nether Blade basic attack to restore mana, and save Kassadin Q Null Sphere until last so you can use it against Ekko's counterattack.
Ekko.escape: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, avoid its area, and look to engage after Ekko E Phase Dive is down. If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, he can still escape with Ekko R Chronobreak, so engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk before Ekko R Chronobreak comes back.
Ekko.fight: When Ekko Q Timewinder flies toward you, use Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield to absorb the poke and move out of its return path. After Ekko E Phase Dive and Ekko R Chronobreak are down, close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk and trade. Before chasing, check your mana to see how many more times you can use Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Ekko.laning: Stay alive and keep up in levels, even if that means giving up dangerous CS. If you've pushed the wave with Kassadin E Force Pulse, retreat into vision.
Ekko.phase: Kassadin gets stronger late game, so scale safely and plan for a longer game.
Ekko.teamfight: Don't start from the front. After immobilizing tools like Ekko W Parallel Convergence have been used and the enemy formation is disrupted, enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Divide your mana before engaging so you can escape with Kassadin R Riftwalk after dealing your burst.
Ekko.watch: Ekko Q Timewinder's returning hit deals more damage, so move out of its return path. When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, stay out of the marked area to avoid its stun and shield. When Ekko's afterimage is visible, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don't recklessly chase even if his health is low.

Fizz.build: Fizz's damage is mostly magic, and Kassadin has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Survive early with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Fizz.combo: To engage, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk, slow him with Kassadin E Force Pulse, then use an empowered Kassadin W Nether Blade basic attack followed by Kassadin Q Null Sphere. Kassadin W Nether Blade restores mana, so save mana for your next Kassadin R Riftwalk or for escaping.
Fizz.escape: The window to engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk is after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down and before it comes back. If Fizz Q Urchin Strike is also available, he can escape, so check whether both mobility abilities have been used. Don't rush in while the crowd control from Fizz R Chum the Waters is still available.
Fizz.fight: Look to counterattack just after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down. If Fizz Q Urchin Strike is still available, he can escape, so check whether he's used it too before closing the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Also look to trade when Fizz misses a last hit with W Seastone Trident.
Fizz.laning: Don't force a push. Keep the wave near your turret, give up dangerous CS, and safely keep up in levels.
Fizz.phase: Early, watch for Fizz to engage and focus on surviving and scaling on Kassadin. Kassadin becomes powerful late game, so scale safely and plan for a longer game.
Fizz.teamfight: Stand close to your allies to bait out Fizz E Playful / Trickster first, then attack Fizz together once it's down. Kassadin shouldn't start from the front; after the enemy's immobilizing effect is used on your frontline, enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Before engaging, save one Kassadin R Riftwalk and enough mana to use it to escape.
Fizz.watch: Fizz E Playful / Trickster is used both to engage and to escape, so don't dive deep before it's down. If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts. Use Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield to absorb incoming magic damage.

Galio.build: Survive early with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Galio's damage is mostly magic, and Kassadin has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Galio.combo: The basic order is to close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk, then use Kassadin E Force Pulse, an empowered Kassadin W Nether Blade basic attack, and Kassadin Q Null Sphere. Hold him with the slow from Kassadin E Force Pulse, and restore mana with Kassadin W Nether Blade to set up your next Kassadin R Riftwalk. Save Kassadin Q Null Sphere until last and use it when you need its shield.
Galio.escape: Don't go in just because Galio E Justice Punch is down; check whether Galio R Hero's Entrance is also available. In particular, engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk during the window before Galio R Hero's Entrance comes back when the taunt from Galio W Shield of Durand is also down. Before going in, save enough mana for one Kassadin R Riftwalk to escape.
Galio.fight: Use Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield to absorb poke from Galio Q Winds of War. While Galio W Shield of Durand is charging, don't commit your damage; move out of taunt range. After Galio E Justice Punch and Galio R Hero's Entrance are down, close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk and trade.
Galio.laning: If Galio has spent mana using abilities to clear the wave, push the lane to limit his opportunity to intervene in another lane with Galio R Hero's Entrance. After pushing, retreat into vision.
Galio.phase: Late game, Kassadin becomes powerful once Kassadin R Riftwalk is leveled up enough, so scale on the side lane and prepare to join fights.
Galio.teamfight: While Galio R Hero's Entrance is ready, don't start small fights with Galio's team in other lanes either. In teamfights, don't start from the front; after Galio's crowd control is used on your frontline, enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Divide your mana and R casts before engaging so you can deal burst damage and then escape with Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Galio.watch: Galio Q Winds of War deals damage over time based on max health where the gusts overlap, so avoid that spot. When Galio starts charging W Shield of Durand, his damage taken is reduced; stop attacking and move out of taunt range. Dodge Galio E Justice Punch when you see its brief windup backward, and move out of range immediately when you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance.

Hwei.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Hwei's magic damage early. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots, and continue prioritizing magic resistance over armor afterward.
Hwei.combo: When Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and slow him with Kassadin E Force Pulse. Follow with an empowered Kassadin W Nether Blade basic attack to restore mana, then use Kassadin Q Null Sphere.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility, but he can stop your engage with Hwei E Subject: Torment. Enter with Kassadin R Riftwalk during the window when that ability is down; if Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, don't dive in first.
Hwei.fight: Close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk just after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or waveclear. Use Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield to absorb Hwei's magic poke, and before engaging save enough mana for one R to escape.
Hwei.laning: Don't force a push. Keep the wave near your turret and give up a few dangerous CS. If you see the eye left by Hwei E Subject: Torment, don't approach along its path.
Hwei.phase: In the late game, safely farm side waves and join fights to make use of Kassadin's scaling power.
Hwei.teamfight: Don't start from the front. After Hwei E Subject: Torment is used and the enemy formation is disrupted, enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Deal damage with Kassadin E Force Pulse and an empowered Kassadin W Nether Blade basic attack, then escape with the R you saved. Take a wide detour around corridors with Hwei's ground effects or eyes.
Hwei.watch: If you're caught by the root or forced movement from Hwei E Subject: Torment, you're likely to be hit by follow-up abilities too. If you're hit by the first ability, immediately reposition to avoid the second ability and Hwei P Signature of the Visionary's explosion. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster also deals damage based on max or missing health, so be especially careful at low health.

Irelia.build: Buy Cloth Armor first. Irelia deals mostly physical damage, and Kassadin has relatively low armor, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Irelia.combo: After Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse → Kassadin W Nether Blade empowered attack → Kassadin Q Null Sphere. Kassadin W Nether Blade restores mana for your next Kassadin R Riftwalk, and save Kassadin Q Null Sphere for when you need its shield.
Irelia.escape: Once Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia E Flawless Duet are down, you have a window to go in with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Irelia Q Bladesurge is a mobility tool and Irelia E Flawless Duet applies a stun, so check whether she has used both before engaging. When chasing, save enough mana for Kassadin R Riftwalk to get out.
Irelia.fight: Avoid risky trades early and look for an opening after Irelia Q Bladesurge is down. Keep one Kassadin R Riftwalk cast in mind for getting back out before you engage.
Irelia.laning: If there is a low-health minion between you and Irelia, step back because it gives her a path to engage with Irelia Q Bladesurge. If you’ve pushed the lane, retreat into vision so the enemy jungler can’t catch you.
Irelia.phase: A scaled Kassadin is strong later, so level up safely and collect side lane waves when there’s no teamfight.
Irelia.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front. Wait until an immobilizing effect such as Irelia E Flawless Duet is used on your frontline, then go in. Irelia has a major impact on teamfights with Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet, so prioritize her. Deal damage after entering with Kassadin R Riftwalk, but save casts and mana for your exit.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to reach you, so create distance when minions are about to die. Avoid the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you’re trapped in Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait for the blades to disappear.

Karma.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Karma’s magic damage, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Since Karma’s main damage is magic, build magic resistance first. If the enemy team is mostly magic damage and uses targeted immobilizing effects to stop your engage, fit in Banshee’s Veil.
Karma.combo: Engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk, slow with Kassadin E Force Pulse, then use Kassadin W Nether Blade’s empowered attack. Save Kassadin Q Null Sphere for last so its shield absorbs the magic poke that follows. When chaining Kassadin R Riftwalk to chase, account for the mana you’ll need to get out.
Karma.escape: Once Karma W Focused Resolve is down, you have a window to go in with Kassadin R Riftwalk. If Karma E empowered by Karma R Mantra has applied a shield, wait for its duration to end before engaging. If Karma W Focused Resolve has already tethered you, use Kassadin R Riftwalk to create distance and break the tether before the root lands.
Karma.fight: Use Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield to absorb Karma Q Inner Flame poke and avoid taking risky trades. Close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk after Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma E empowered by Karma R Mantra has expired. Before going in, count how many more times you can use Kassadin R Riftwalk and save enough for your exit.
Karma.laning: Don’t waste Kassadin Q Null Sphere on minions; use it to absorb Karma’s magic poke. Stay alive and keep up in levels, even if you miss a few CS.
Karma.phase: A scaled Kassadin is strong later, so level up safely even if it means giving up ground early.
Karma.teamfight: After Karma W Focused Resolve is used on your frontline and the enemy formation is disrupted, enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk. If Karma E empowered by Karma R Mantra has shielded her nearby allies, hold your burst until it ends. Plan how many Kassadin R Riftwalk casts to spend on engaging and disengaging, then attack and get back out.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame is an area slow used to poke, so stand behind minions or outside its range to avoid being hit. If you are hit by the fire circle left by Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra, walk out before the area detonates again. If you are tethered by Karma W Focused Resolve, create distance before it roots you.

Leblanc.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. LeBlanc deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If you need extra defense, Banshee’s Veil can block one opening spell.
Leblanc.combo: When LeBlanc W Distortion’s return window ends or her mobility spell is used, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and slow her with Kassadin E Force Pulse. Follow with Kassadin W Nether Blade’s empowered attack to restore mana, then use Kassadin Q Null Sphere last. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains is still available, save Kassadin R Riftwalk for your escape.
Leblanc.escape: Right after making LeBlanc use LeBlanc W Distortion is your chance to close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk. It’s safer to fight at close range if LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains is also down and LeBlanc W Distortion’s return window has ended. If you’ve been hit by the chains, prioritize using Kassadin R Riftwalk to get out of range over engaging.
Leblanc.fight: Early on, use Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield to absorb LeBlanc’s magic poke and avoid risky trades. It’s safer to engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk after LeBlanc W Distortion’s return window expires or its return has already been used. Before going in, account for the mana you’ll need to chase and one Kassadin R Riftwalk cast to get out.
Leblanc.laning: Stay alive and keep up in levels, even if you miss a few CS. Alert your team immediately if LeBlanc disappears from mid lane vision.
Leblanc.phase: Early on, withstand LeBlanc’s poke and buy time for Kassadin to scale. Kassadin gets stronger later, so scale safely and drag the game out.
Leblanc.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front. Wait for an immobilizing tool such as LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains to be used on your frontline and for the enemy formation to become disrupted. Then enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk, deal damage, and escape with the Kassadin R Riftwalk cast you saved. While there’s no fight, farm side lane waves and use Kassadin R Riftwalk to join your team.
Leblanc.watch: If the mark from LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice is on you, the next spell will deal more damage, so back away until it disappears. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, use Kassadin R Riftwalk to get beyond its range before the root lands. Don’t chase immediately when LeBlanc W Distortion brings her in; watch to see if the time to return to her original position expires.

Lissandra.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Lissandra deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If her immobilizing effects keep stopping your engages, fit in Banshee’s Veil to block the first spell and create a window to close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Lissandra.combo: After Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk, use Kassadin E Force Pulse, then Kassadin W Nether Blade’s empowered attack followed by Kassadin Q Null Sphere. Kassadin W Nether Blade restores mana for your next Kassadin R Riftwalk. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is available, don’t dump all your burst at once; spread your damage until the stasis from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb cast on herself ends.
Lissandra.escape: Right after Lissandra W Ring of Frost is used, its root is down, so you can start a trade. The window to close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk is right after Lissandra E Glacial Path is also used. If the stun from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is still available, use fewer Kassadin R Riftwalk casts to engage and save mana for your exit.
Lissandra.fight: Trade when Lissandra W Ring of Frost is used on the wave or misses. If Lissandra E Glacial Path is also down, close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Before engaging, count how many times your remaining mana lets you use Kassadin R Riftwalk, and save one cast to get out.
Lissandra.laning: Stand at an angle to your allied minions to avoid Lissandra Q Ice Shard’s piercing path, and keep the wave near your turret. Stay alive and keep up in levels, even if you miss a few CS; if you push the wave, retreat into vision.
Lissandra.phase: Kassadin gets much stronger later, so farm side lane waves and join fights when they break out.
Lissandra.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front. Wait until an immobilizing ability such as Lissandra W Ring of Frost or Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is used on your frontline, then go in. Check whether Lissandra E Glacial Path is already down, then enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk and burst them. Save Kassadin R Riftwalk and mana to get back out.
Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces after hitting a minion, so don’t stand in a line with your allied minions. Lissandra W Ring of Frost’s root and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb’s stun can set up repeated damage, so don’t force an engage while both spells are available. If Lissandra casts Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on herself, she becomes immune to damage, so spread out your damage until the stasis ends.

Lux.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Lux’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots and build magic resistance.
Lux.combo: When Lux Q Light Binding misses, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse. Follow with Kassadin W Nether Blade’s empowered attack, then finish with Kassadin Q Null Sphere. Chase while accounting for the mana you need for your next Kassadin R Riftwalk and your exit.
Lux.escape: Lux has no mobility spell, so the moment Lux Q Light Binding misses is your chance to engage. Close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk then, and save enough mana for the R cast you’ll need to get out.
Lux.fight: Close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk after Lux Q Light Binding misses. Time Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield to absorb Lux’s magic poke, and if a spell hits you, create distance so Lux can’t trigger the Lux P Illumination mark with a basic attack.
Lux.laning: Stand apart from your allies to the side so you can dodge Lux Q Light Binding. Stay alive and keep up in levels, even if you miss a few CS.
Lux.phase: Farm side lane waves to scale later, then join when a fight breaks out.
Lux.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front. Wait until an immobilizing spell such as Lux Q Light Binding is used on your frontline, then go in. Approach spread out from your allies so Lux E Lucent Singularity can’t catch you all together. Enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk, burst them, and get out with the R cast you saved.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, you’re likely to take follow-up spells too, so bait it out and dodge. It can bind up to two targets even if an ally is in front, so don’t stand in a line with your ally. When you see the red targeting line from Lux R Final Spark, sidestep.

Malzahar.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Malzahar’s main magic damage, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first. If you need protection from Malzahar’s engage denial, fit in Banshee’s Veil.
Malzahar.combo: Before engaging, break Malzahar P Void Shift with Kassadin Q Null Sphere. When you don’t need to worry about Malzahar Q Call of the Void or Malzahar R Nether Grasp, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse, then Kassadin W Nether Blade’s empowered attack. Before chaining Kassadin R Riftwalk casts, make sure you have enough mana left to escape.
Malzahar.escape: Malzahar has no spell to create distance, so after dodging Malzahar Q Call of the Void is your chance to close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk. If Malzahar can use Malzahar R Nether Grasp, don’t engage alone; wait until an ally can interrupt the cast.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, damage and crowd control have little effect, so break it first before fighting. Dodge Malzahar Q Call of the Void and close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk during a window when Malzahar can’t use Malzahar R Nether Grasp. Restore mana with Kassadin W Nether Blade’s empowered attack, but save one Kassadin R Riftwalk cast to get out.
Malzahar.laning: Don’t stand near a minion that is about to die with Malzahar E Malefic Visions on it. If Malzahar has pushed the lane, break Malzahar P Void Shift and look for a chance to go in with your jungler.
Malzahar.phase: Early on, Kassadin should withstand poke and level up safely. Kassadin is strong later, but in this matchup Malzahar also becomes more threatening as the game goes on, so slow his scaling early with your jungler.
Malzahar.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front. After Malzahar’s immobilizing effect is used on your frontline, enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk. If Malzahar W Void Swarm’s summons are already out, clear them first with an area spell such as Kassadin E Force Pulse, then engage. Before going in, save Kassadin R Riftwalk and mana to get out.
Malzahar.watch: When a minion afflicted by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect transfers to a nearby enemy, so move away from that minion. When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, dodge toward the outside of the portals and delay your engage until the silence ends. Malzahar R Nether Grasp’s suppression can’t be removed with Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield or Kassadin R Riftwalk, so don’t enter an area without vision alone while Malzahar can use R.

Mel.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Mel’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots and build magic resistance first.
Mel.combo: Dodge Mel E Solar Snare, and when Mel W Rebuttal is down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse. Follow with Kassadin W Nether Blade’s empowered attack to restore mana, then use Kassadin Q Null Sphere. When chasing, check that you have mana for your next Kassadin R Riftwalk and your exit.
Mel.escape: Mel has no mobility spell, so after dodging the root from Mel E Solar Snare is your chance to engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk. If Mel W Rebuttal is also down, you have a window to use Kassadin Q Null Sphere. If you’re about to be hit in the center of Mel E Solar Snare, save Kassadin R Riftwalk to dodge it instead of engaging.
Mel.fight: Before engaging, count how many times you can use Kassadin R Riftwalk and save mana for your exit.
Mel.laning: Early on, secure CS and levels while keeping the wave near your turret. Once you have Kassadin R Riftwalk, pressure Mel when it’s safe so she can’t stack Mel R Golden Eclipse for long. If you push the wave, retreat into vision so the enemy jungler can’t catch you.
Mel.phase: Kassadin gets strong later, but Mel also gets stronger as she permanently stacks Mel R Golden Eclipse, so limit her chances to scale with safe pressure.
Mel.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front. After an enemy immobilizing effect such as Mel E Solar Snare is used on your frontline, enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Deal damage with Kassadin E Force Pulse and Kassadin W Nether Blade’s empowered attack, and save enough mana for Kassadin R Riftwalk to get out. After the fight, if Mel’s Overwhelm stacks remain, watch out for Mel R Golden Eclipse and wait somewhere safe.
Mel.watch: If Mel E Solar Snare hits you in the center, it roots you and makes Mel Q Radiant Volley easy to land, so sidestep it. Hold Kassadin Q Null Sphere while Mel W Rebuttal is active, and test her response with a basic attack before using it. If stacks of Mel P Searing Brilliance are on you, watch out for the execute even while you still have health, and after leaving a fight, beware of Mel R Golden Eclipse until the stacks disappear.

Naafiri.build: Buy Cloth Armor early to withstand her damage, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Naafiri deals mostly physical damage, and Kassadin has relatively low armor, so build armor first. If extended fights make the healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate difficult to handle, consider anti-heal next.
Naafiri.combo: After Naafiri’s mobility spell is down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse, Kassadin W Nether Blade’s empowered attack, then Kassadin Q Null Sphere. Even if Kassadin W Nether Blade restores mana, account for the mana you’ll need to escape with Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Naafiri.escape: Check whether Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate are down, and especially look for a chance to engage before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes back. If the slow from Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is still active or only one mobility spell is down, wait because she can respond with her remaining spells. After going in, save one Kassadin R Riftwalk cast to get out.
Naafiri.fight: If the first dagger from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you, stop trading and back away until the bleed ends. When Naafiri E Eviscerate is down and Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is unavailable, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and keep her close with Kassadin E Force Pulse’s slow. Before engaging, save enough mana for Kassadin R Riftwalk to get out.
Naafiri.laning: Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield absorbs magic damage, so don’t rely on it to block Naafiri’s main physical damage. If you push the wave with Kassadin E Force Pulse, retreat into vision so the enemy jungler can’t catch you.
Naafiri.phase: Early on, Kassadin should focus on surviving and scaling, so stay alive and keep up in levels even if you give up a few CS. In the mid game, watch for Naafiri’s roams and attempts to catch you alone, and keep vision spread out. Later, use Kassadin’s scaling and Kassadin R Riftwalk’s shorter cooldown to look for front to back teamfights where area damage can clear Naafiri’s pack.
Naafiri.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front. Move with your allies and avoid positions where Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit can catch you alone. When an enemy immobilizing effect is used on your frontline and the formation is disrupted, enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk, deal damage, and get back out. Naafiri can use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit again right after one of your allies dies, so retreat immediately to avoid being caught in succession.
Naafiri.watch: If you’re hit once by Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, create distance until the bleed ends to avoid the heavy damage from a second hit. Naafiri E Eviscerate dashes, restores her health, and revives her pack, so don’t fight immediately after clearing the pack. Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is a slowing dash, so don’t expose yourself alone while it’s available.

Neeko.build: Build Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Neeko's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and build magic resistance first.
Neeko.combo: If Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and slow her with Kassadin E Force Pulse. Follow with an empowered basic attack from Kassadin W Nether Blade, and use Kassadin Q Null Sphere last so you can block Neeko's counterattack.
Neeko.escape: Engage while Neeko E Tangle-Barbs or Neeko R Pop Blossom is down. If Neeko sends out a clone with Neeko W Shapesplitter, don't follow it; identify the real Neeko before using Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Neeko.laning: Don't force the wave out; keep it near your turret, give up dangerous last hits, and keep up in levels.
Neeko.phase: The early game is a period when Neeko can poke Kassadin, so focus on surviving and scaling. Kassadin grows stronger later, so secure time to scale safely.
Neeko.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies so Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and Neeko R Pop Blossom don't catch several of you at once. After Neeko's immobilizing effects is used on your frontline, enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk and deal burst damage. Save enough mana for R to get out.
Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up if it hits something first, so don't stand in a line behind minions or allies. If Neeko approaches while transformed, you may not see Neeko R Pop Blossom's startup, so create distance before she gets close. Don't chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter; track the real Neeko.

Orianna.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first to survive the early game. Orianna's damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Orianna.combo: To engage, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse, land an empowered basic attack from Kassadin W Nether Blade, then use Kassadin Q Null Sphere. Restore mana with Kassadin W Nether Blade to set up your next Kassadin R Riftwalk. Before chasing further, check whether you can save enough mana to get out.
Orianna.escape: Orianna has no ability to create distance on her own, so engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk when the ball is away from her and Orianna R Command: Shockwave is down. It's even easier to close the gap if Orianna W Command: Dissonance's slow is also down. Save enough for Kassadin R Riftwalk to get out before you go in.
Orianna.fight: Right after Orianna throws the ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack, exploit the window when she lacks the armor and magic resistance from Orianna E Command: Protect's passive. Close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk, then slow and catch her with Kassadin E Force Pulse. Don't trade early while taking repeated basic attacks from Orianna P Clockwork Windup.
Orianna.laning: It's better to survive and scale than to die for a few last hits. If you've pushed the wave with Kassadin E Force Pulse, retreat into vision.
Orianna.phase: Survive and scale as Kassadin against Orianna's ranged poke early. Kassadin grows stronger later, so keep up in levels safely and play for a longer game.
Orianna.teamfight: Track Orianna's ball, and engage after forced movement such as Orianna R Command: Shockwave has been used on your frontline. Get onto the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk, deal burst damage, then escape with another Kassadin R Riftwalk. Scale on side waves before a fight, but account for the mana you'll need to join and leave.
Orianna.watch: The area around the ball moved by Orianna Q Command: Attack is where Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in, so dodge based on the ball's position rather than Orianna's. Also watch for the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance and repeated basic attacks from Orianna P Clockwork Windup. Absorb her magic poke with Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield.

Qiyana.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Qiyana's main damage is physical and Kassadin has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Qiyana.combo: If Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity are down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse → Kassadin W Nether Blade empowered basic attack → Kassadin Q Null Sphere. Use Kassadin E Force Pulse's slow to keep her close, then restore mana with Kassadin W Nether Blade to set up your next Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Qiyana.escape: Engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk once both Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity are down and you've avoided the risk of being rooted or stunned. Look especially for a window before Qiyana E Audacity comes back, and don't enter a position with your back to a wall if Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent is still available.
Qiyana.fight: Look for a chance to counterattack right after Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity are down. If only one is down, she can escape with the other mobility spell, so don't rush in. Before engaging, account for the mana you'll need for Kassadin R Riftwalk and one cast to get out.
Qiyana.laning: Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield is for magic damage, so don't step forward expecting it to absorb Qiyana's main physical poke.
Qiyana.phase: Survive and scale as Kassadin early, and avoid giving up advantages during Qiyana's strong mid game. Kassadin grows stronger later while Qiyana becomes relatively weaker, so scale safely and aim for that stage.
Qiyana.teamfight: Don't start the fight from the front, and avoid walls and narrow terrain where Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent can easily hit. When the enemy's immobilizing effects is used on your frontline and the formation breaks, enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk and deal burst damage. Save a cast of Kassadin R Riftwalk and enough mana to get out.
Qiyana.watch: Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal can apply a root or grant stealth depending on the element she holds, so watch the element and adjust your distance. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes and stuns when it hits terrain, so avoid fighting with your back to a wall or in a narrow passage. Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield absorbs magic damage, so don't rely on it to block Qiyana's main source of physical damage.

Ryze.build: Survive with Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ryze's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Ryze.combo: Close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse, then an empowered basic attack from Kassadin W Nether Blade, followed by Kassadin Q Null Sphere. Restore mana with the W basic attack to set up your next R, and save Q to interrupt Ryze R Realm Warp.
Ryze.escape: If Ryze E Spell Flux misses, Ryze W Rune Prison only slows instead of rooting, so look for a chance to engage. You can also close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk while Ryze R Realm Warp is down. Before going in, plan how many R casts you can use to chase and still have enough mana to escape.
Ryze.fight: After learning Kassadin R Riftwalk, watch for Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze W Rune Prison, and use R to close the gap when Ryze R Realm Warp is down.
Ryze.laning: Even if you have to give up a few dangerous last hits, survive and keep up in levels. If you've pushed the wave with Kassadin E Force Pulse, retreat into vision.
Ryze.phase: Early on, Kassadin needs to endure poke and scale, and Ryze also lacks mana and damage in the early game.
Ryze.teamfight: Don't start from the front. After an immobilizing effect such as Ryze W Rune Prison is used on your frontline, enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Before going in, budget your mana and R casts so you can deal burst damage and still use R to escape.
Ryze.watch: If Ryze E Spell Flux hits you, keep your distance from allies until the mark disappears. While the mark remains, Ryze W Rune Prison roots you and Ryze Q Overload deals increased damage, so dodge E first and absorb his magic poke with Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield.

Sylas.build: Build Null-Magic Mantle first to survive the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Sylas deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first.
Sylas.combo: While Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse. Follow with an empowered basic attack from Kassadin W Nether Blade to restore mana, then use Kassadin Q Null Sphere last to absorb his counterattack with the shield. Save enough mana to escape with your next Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Sylas.escape: The window to engage is right after you dodge the second chain of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Sylas W Kingslayer is also a mobility spell, so don't chase deep just because E is down. Before you go in, count how many more times you can cast Kassadin R Riftwalk and save enough for an escape.
Sylas.fight: Early on, use Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield to absorb magic poke and survive short trades. After Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down, close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse's slow to keep him close as you trade. If Sylas W Kingslayer is still available, account for its dash and healing and don't rush to finish him.
Sylas.laning: Keep the wave near your turret, and choose survival over a few last hits if you're in danger. If you've pushed the wave after leveling up Kassadin E Force Pulse, retreat into vision so the enemy jungler can't catch you.
Sylas.phase: Kassadin grows stronger later, so safely build levels and CS and play for a longer game.
Sylas.teamfight: Don't start from the front; engage after the enemy's immobilizing abilities, such as Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, is used on your frontline. When the formation breaks, get onto the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk and deal burst damage, then escape with the Kassadin R Riftwalk you saved. When there is no fight, farm side waves and join when one breaks out.
Sylas.watch: If the second chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct hits, it knocks you up and lets him follow with more attacks, so use Kassadin R Riftwalk to dodge the chain rather than the initial dash. Sylas Q Chain Lash explodes late at the intersection, so move away immediately even if you only get clipped by the first hit. Sylas W Kingslayer heals more based on his missing health, so don't delay too long before finishing him after lowering his health.

Syndra.build: Survive with Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against Syndra's main damage, while also watching your total health against the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.combo: If Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse. Follow with an empowered basic attack from Kassadin W Nether Blade to restore mana, then use Kassadin Q Null Sphere. Before chasing, first account for the mana you'll need for your next Kassadin R Riftwalk and to get out.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak has a long cooldown and is her only self-peel, so look to engage immediately after it's used.
Syndra.fight: Absorb Syndra's magic poke with Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield. After Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse's slow to keep her close for a short trade.
Syndra.laning: Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak can be dodged on foot, so get boots early. Give up dangerous last hits and focus on surviving and scaling.
Syndra.teamfight: Don't start from the front. After an immobilizing effect such as Syndra E Scatter the Weak is used on your frontline, enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Avoid areas with several Syndra Q Dark Spheres, where Syndra R Unleashed Power is dangerous, and save enough mana to escape with Kassadin R Riftwalk before you engage.
Syndra.watch: If Syndra Q Dark Sphere is between you and Syndra, Syndra E Scatter the Weak can knock it into you and stun you, so move off the sphere's line. Syndra W Force of Will slows and deals true damage, so dodge the area where she throws it. When several spheres are on the ground, watch out for the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.

Talon.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor to withstand Talon's physical damage, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Prioritize armor over magic resistance. Since Talon has flat penetration, don't stop at a small amount of armor; build health as well.
Talon.combo: When Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse → Kassadin W Nether Blade empowered attack → Kassadin Q Null Sphere. Using Kassadin R Riftwalk again to chase costs a lot of mana, so save enough to get out first.
Talon.escape: Look to engage right after Talon uses Q Noxian Diplomacy. Dodge the returning hit from Talon W Rake, and look to retaliate once Talon R Shadow Assault is also down. Talon can create distance again with E Assassin's Path, so save one Kassadin R Riftwalk to get out.
Talon.fight: Right after Talon uses Q Noxian Diplomacy, look for a chance to close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Slow him with Kassadin E Force Pulse, then restore mana with an empowered attack from Kassadin W Nether Blade. Look to retaliate once you confirm Talon R Shadow Assault is down.
Talon.laning: Talon can roam over terrain, so share his position and ward jungle paths.
Talon.phase: Talon's trades are strong early, so Kassadin should stay alive and keep up in levels, even if that means giving up a few CS. Kassadin gets stronger later while Talon's influence wanes, so keep scaling and extend the game.
Talon.teamfight: Don't engage from the front. Wait until the enemy uses an immobilizing effect on your frontline, then enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk. If Talon gets into your backline, group with your allies to respond and look to retaliate once Talon R Shadow Assault is down. Before engaging, save enough mana and casts of Kassadin R Riftwalk to get out.
Talon.watch: If Talon W Rake hits you on the way out, move out of the path it takes on its return. Getting hit twice makes Talon P Blade's End's follow-up stronger, making trades especially dangerous early. While Talon R Shadow Assault is available, account for its stealth and movement speed boost, and don't chase recklessly.

TwistedFate.build: Build Null-Magic Mantle first to survive the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Twisted Fate's damage is mostly magic and Kassadin has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
TwistedFate.combo: To engage, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse, land an empowered basic attack from Kassadin W Nether Blade, then use Kassadin Q Null Sphere. Keep him close with Kassadin E Force Pulse's slow and restore mana with Kassadin W Nether Blade to set up your next Kassadin R Riftwalk. Save Kassadin Q Null Sphere to interrupt Twisted Fate R Destiny if he tries to cast it.
TwistedFate.escape: The chance to engage is right after Twisted Fate uses the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Before you go in, account for the mana you'll need for your chase and one Kassadin R Riftwalk to get out.
TwistedFate.fight: Don't force an engage while Twisted Fate is holding a gold card. Close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk and trade after he's used the card or is holding a blue or red card. Restore mana with an empowered basic attack from Kassadin W Nether Blade, but save enough for your next R and to escape.
TwistedFate.laning: Don't force the wave out; keep it near your turret and give up dangerous last hits.
TwistedFate.phase: Kassadin grows stronger later, so survive and keep up in levels, even if that means accepting early losses.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Don't start from the front; engage after the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card has been used. Get onto the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk, deal burst damage, then escape with the R you saved. When there is no fight, farm side waves and join when a teamfight breaks out.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate has locked in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay outside its range. Reduce the poke from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards by standing behind minions, and absorb hits with Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield.

Veigar.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Veigar's magic damage early. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and build magic resistance over armor.
Veigar.combo: After Veigar E Event Horizon is down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse. Follow with an empowered basic attack from Kassadin W Nether Blade to restore mana, then use Kassadin Q Null Sphere last. Before chasing, check whether you have enough mana left for your next Kassadin R Riftwalk and to get out.
Veigar.escape: Veigar has no mobility spell, so when Veigar E Event Horizon is down, look for a chance to engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk. If you're trapped inside E Event Horizon, don't rush toward the edge; save Kassadin R Riftwalk to escape.
Veigar.laning: Stand behind minions so Veigar Q Baleful Strike doesn't hit you for free and help Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power stack. Keep the wave near your turret early and use Kassadin Q Null Sphere to block magic poke while collecting CS and experience. Look for chances to pressure Veigar while he's weak early, but give up a few last hits if you're at risk of dying.
Veigar.phase: Kassadin grows strong later, but Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power keeps stacking, so track Veigar's position and whether he's used E Event Horizon when fighting.
Veigar.teamfight: Don't start from the front. After crowd control such as Veigar E Event Horizon is used on your frontline, enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Before you go in, budget your mana and casts so you can deal burst damage and still escape with another Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns when you cross its edge, so if you're trapped inside, don't run into the edge; move around inside and wait for it to disappear. Dodge Veigar W Dark Matter by watching the ground indicator and moving to the side. If your health is below half, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on your missing health.

Vex.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Vex's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and prioritize magic resistance.
Vex.combo: After Vex P Doom 'n Gloom has been used, attack in this order: Kassadin R Riftwalk → Kassadin E Force Pulse → Kassadin W Nether Blade empowered attack → Kassadin Q Null Sphere. It's an even better chance to attack if Vex W Personal Space's shield is also down. Save Kassadin Q Null Sphere until the end to use its shield against Vex's magic damage.
Vex.escape: Engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk after Vex uses P Doom 'n Gloom and W Personal Space. If Vex R Shadow Surge is also down, she has no way to move. Conversely, delay your engage while Vex's Doom indicator is showing.
Vex.fight: Look for a chance when Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is down and Vex W Personal Space's shield is unavailable. Close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk, slow her with Kassadin E Force Pulse, then restore mana with an empowered attack from Kassadin W Nether Blade. Before engaging, save enough mana for one Kassadin R Riftwalk to get out.
Vex.laning: Don't force the wave forward; keep it near your turret. Give up dangerous CS and prioritize staying alive.
Vex.phase: Early on, Kassadin needs to withstand poke and scale. Kassadin gets stronger later, so farm side waves and join fights.
Vex.teamfight: After dealing burst damage, save enough mana to get out with R. Low-health allies should get out of Vex's range first so she can't reset her ultimate with an initial kill using Vex R Shadow Surge.
Vex.watch: Wait until Vex uses Doom 'n Gloom on the wave or to poke. If Vex R Shadow Surge hits you and marks you, move toward your allies and prepare for Vex's dash.

Viktor.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Since Viktor deals mostly magic damage, prioritize magic resistance.
Viktor.combo: After dodging the stun from Viktor W Gravity Field, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and slow him with Kassadin E Force Pulse. Follow with an empowered attack from Kassadin W Nether Blade, then finish with Kassadin Q Null Sphere.
Viktor.escape: Viktor has no dash to escape on his own, so after dodging Viktor W Gravity Field is a chance to engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Before engaging, save one Kassadin R Riftwalk and enough mana for your escape.
Viktor.laning: Don't push the wave; keep it near your turret and safely collect CS and experience. Don't stand where Viktor E Hextech Ray is angled toward the wave, and use Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield when poke comes in.
Viktor.phase: Kassadin needs to withstand poke early, but Viktor is also at his weakest before he has scaling stacks. Kassadin gets strong later, but Viktor's stacks grow permanently too, so don't expect trades to stay the same as his augmentations accumulate.
Viktor.teamfight: Don't start from the front. After the enemy's crowd control, such as Viktor W Gravity Field, has been used, enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Avoid stepping into Viktor W Gravity Field's area, deal your burst damage, then escape with the Kassadin R Riftwalk you saved.
Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray can hit you along with the wave if you stand in line with minions, so stand off to the side. Leave Viktor W Gravity Field immediately to avoid the stun, and don't stay in the area of Viktor R Arcane Storm's area damage.

Vladimir.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Since Vladimir deals mostly magic damage, prioritize magic resistance; add anti-healing if the duel goes long.
Vladimir.combo: After Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse, Kassadin W Nether Blade empowered attack, then Kassadin Q Null Sphere. Account for the mana restored by Kassadin W Nether Blade and save enough for your next Kassadin R Riftwalk and escape.
Vladimir.escape: First bait out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool; when it ends, that's your chance to engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Vladimir moves more slowly while charging E Tides of Blood, which also makes it a good time to close the gap.
Vladimir.fight: While Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is available, hold your important abilities. Bait out the pool first, then close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk as it ends. Use Kassadin E Force Pulse to slow him and maintain distance, then restore mana with an empowered attack from Kassadin W Nether Blade.
Vladimir.laning: Vladimir is also weak at this stage, so avoid risky solo fights and help apply early pressure when a gank opportunity comes up. Give up dangerous CS and keep up in levels.
Vladimir.phase: Both champions are weak early, but Kassadin should focus on surviving poke, staying alive, and scaling. Kassadin scales strongly into the late game, and Vladimir also gets harder to deal with as he scales, so secure safe opportunities to keep growing.
Vladimir.teamfight: Don't group up and let multiple people get hit by Vladimir R Hemoplague. If you're infected, join the fight after the effect ends. Kassadin shouldn't start from the front; wait until the enemy uses a crowd control effect on your frontline, then enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Save one Kassadin R Riftwalk and enough mana to get out.
Vladimir.watch: Vladimir Q Transfusion heals him and becomes empowered, so absorb its poke with Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield. When Vladimir charges E Tides of Blood, put minions between you or move out of range. Hemoplague increases the damage you take, so avoid fighting until Vladimir R Hemoplague wears off.

Xerath.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to withstand his damage, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Xerath's main damage is magic, and Kassadin has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Xerath.combo: When Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse. Follow with an empowered attack from Kassadin W Nether Blade to restore mana, and use Kassadin Q Null Sphere last.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so the window to engage is right after Xerath E Shocking Orb's stun and Xerath W Eye of Destruction's slow are down. Close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk then, but decide whether to save one R and enough mana to escape before chasing.
Xerath.fight: Once you're in range, slow him with Kassadin E Force Pulse and restore mana with an empowered attack from Kassadin W Nether Blade.
Xerath.laning: Early on, don't push the wave; keep it near your turret and safely collect CS and experience. Use Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield when Xerath's magic poke comes in, and let him spend mana while you avoid heavy damage. When Xerath runs low on mana, push the lane and call your jungler, then fall back within vision after pushing.
Xerath.phase: Kassadin's scaling is his strength later, so safely farm waves and extend the game.
Xerath.teamfight: Don't start from the front. After the enemy uses a crowd control ability such as Xerath E Shocking Orb on your frontline, enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Before engaging, decide how many times you'll use R to go in and get out, then deal your burst damage and escape with R. Farm side waves while no fight is happening, then join when a teamfight starts.
Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so when you see him charging it, change direction and dodge to the side. If Xerath E Shocking Orb stuns you, you're likely to take the magic damage that follows, so hold off on engaging until it's down. When Xerath R Rite of the Arcane begins, dodge immediately or, if you can safely close in, engage Xerath while he can't move.

Yasuo.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor. Yasuo’s main damage is physical, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots.
Yasuo.combo: Break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first, then close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk while his tornado is down. Slow him with Kassadin E Force Pulse, then use Kassadin W Nether Blade’s empowered basic attack to get mana back, and save Kassadin Q Null Sphere for last. When using Kassadin R Riftwalk repeatedly, keep track of how much mana you have left.
Yasuo.escape: The moment after Yasuo throws Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado is your chance to engage. If Yasuo R Last Breath is not back up yet, close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk alongside crowd control. Before going in, save one Kassadin R Riftwalk to get out and the mana it requires.
Yasuo.fight: Use light trades to break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first. After you dodge Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado, or just after Yasuo throws it and his stacks reset, close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk and slow him with Kassadin E Force Pulse. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so don’t chase deep just because he used it once.
Yasuo.laning: When the wave is pushing toward your side in a thin line, Yasuo has fewer minions to use as stepping stones with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. If you’re at a disadvantage, give up a few CS and stay alive to scale. After pushing the lane, retreat into vision.
Yasuo.phase: Kassadin grows stronger in the late game, so play to scale safely and let the game go long.
Yasuo.teamfight: Don’t start the fight from the front. Wait until the enemy uses their immobilizing effects on your frontline and their formation breaks up. Then use Kassadin R Riftwalk to get into the backline and deal damage, and escape with the Kassadin R Riftwalk you saved. When there’s no fight, farm waves in a side lane and join when a team fight starts.
