Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest can knock you up with a tornado after hitting twice in a row. When his stacks are full, move out of the line and dodge to the side. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use minions to close the gap, so watch your distance near large minion waves. Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield blocks magic damage, so don’t rely on it to block the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or Yasuo R Last Breath.

Yone.build: Get enough movement speed to help you leave the announced attack area. Yone Q Mortal Steel deals physical damage, while Yone P Way of the Hunter deals magic damage, so don't focus on only one resistance if you build resistances. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about choices that add a lot of health alone.
Yone.combo: To engage, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk, slow him with Kassadin E Force Pulse, then use an empowered attack from Kassadin W Nether Blade followed by Kassadin Q Null Sphere. The empowered attack restores mana, giving you room for your next Kassadin R Riftwalk. If Yone still has a way to move, plan your chase casts after the combo and save a Kassadin R Riftwalk to escape.
Yone.escape: The window to engage is after Yone's Q Mortal Steel whirlwind expires and he uses E Soul Unbound, especially before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back. Yone can chain his mobility, so don't spend all your Kassadin R Riftwalk casts chasing just because one ability is down.
Yone.fight: Don't engage first while Yone's whirlwind Q is ready. Yone has several ways to move, so don't rush to chase when just one is down; look especially for a window before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back. If an opportunity opens, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk, but save enough mana and casts to get out.
Yone.laning: When Yone prepares his whirlwind with Q Mortal Steel, keep your distance even if you have to give up a few CS. After pushing the wave with Kassadin E Force Pulse, fall back within vision so the enemy jungler can't catch you.
Yone.phase: Later, safely farm waves and join fights to make use of Kassadin's strength once he has scaled.
Yone.teamfight: Don't start from the front. After the enemy uses a crowd control effect on your frontline, enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Spread out from your allies to reduce the chance that Yone W Spirit Cleave hits multiple people and grants a larger shield. Before going in, decide how many Kassadin R Riftwalk casts to use for entry and exit, then deal your burst damage and get out.
Yone.watch: When Yone repeatedly uses Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his whirlwind, stay out of range until the stacks expire. After Yone E Soul Unbound takes him in, he can deal extra damage when he returns, so create distance before your health gets low. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path, so don't stand alone in the backline just before a teamfight.

Zed.build: Early on, use Cloth Armor to withstand Zed's physical damage. Prioritize armor, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Zed.combo: To engage, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and use Kassadin E Force Pulse, then use an empowered attack from Kassadin W Nether Blade followed by Kassadin Q Null Sphere. Kassadin W Nether Blade restores mana to make room for your next Kassadin R Riftwalk. Zed W Living Shadow and Zed R Death Mark are mobility abilities, so don't expect Kassadin Q Null Sphere to interrupt them.
Zed.escape: Don't engage as soon as Zed W Living Shadow is down. Engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk when Zed R Death Mark is also down and hasn't returned, and when you can avoid the slow from the shadow's Zed E Shadow Slash. If Zed engages first with R Death Mark, create distance with Kassadin R Riftwalk so he can't stack more damage.
Zed.fight: Look for a chance after Zed W Living Shadow expires or after Zed has already repositioned. If Zed R Death Mark is also down and hasn't returned, close the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk, slow him with Kassadin E Force Pulse, and deal damage. Before engaging, save one Kassadin R Riftwalk and enough mana to use it on the way back.
Zed.laning: Zed's main poke deals physical damage, so don't take hits relying only on Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield.
Zed.phase: Zed peaks in the mid game, so be careful not to get caught alone then. Kassadin gets stronger and Zed weaker later, so keep scaling and move with your allies.
Zed.teamfight: Don't start from the front. After the enemy uses a crowd control effect on your frontline and their formation breaks, enter the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Decide in advance how to divide your Kassadin R Riftwalk casts and mana between going in and getting out. Farm side waves while no fight is happening, then join when a fight starts.
Zed.watch: Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash deal physical damage, and the shadow's E also slows, so watch the shadow's position and move out of range. If Zed R Death Mark marks you, create distance so Zed can't stack more damage. Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield absorbs magic damage, so don't count on it to block Zed's main physical damage.

Zoe.build: Early on, withstand her damage with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zoe deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. However, resistance can't reduce the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, so dodging it is important.
Zoe.combo: After Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, close in with Kassadin R Riftwalk and slow her with Kassadin E Force Pulse. Follow with an empowered attack from Kassadin W Nether Blade to restore mana, then use Kassadin Q Null Sphere last. If you use Kassadin R Riftwalk more to chase, account for the mana needed to escape.
Zoe.escape: Right after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down is your window to engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk. You can also close the gap while Zoe R Portal Jump is down. If Zoe has just used R Portal Jump, aim for her starting point when she returns.
Zoe.fight: Avoid risky trades early and time Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield to Zoe's magic poke. After unlocking Kassadin R Riftwalk, close the gap when Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down. If Zoe uses R Portal Jump, look to retaliate at her starting point when she returns.
Zoe.laning: When Zoe pokes, gain a shield with Kassadin Q Null Sphere. Give up dangerous CS and prioritize staying alive. After pushing the wave with Kassadin E Force Pulse, fall back within vision so the enemy jungler can't catch you.
Zoe.phase: Zoe can poke Kassadin easily early, so focus on staying alive and scaling. Kassadin gets stronger later, so safely keep up in levels even if it means giving up ground early.
Zoe.teamfight: Kassadin shouldn't start from the front; go in after the enemy uses a crowd control effect on your frontline. When Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, close in on the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk and deal damage. Save enough mana and casts of Kassadin R Riftwalk to get out.
Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, you'll fall asleep after a short delay and can take heavy damage from the follow-up attack. Prioritize dodging the bubble; if it hits, move out of the angle and range of Zoe Q Paddle Star! before the sleep triggers. A bubble that misses also leaves a trap, so be careful in narrow paths without vision.
